hash_method: sha256 of the word/styles.xml bytes, and sha256 of the UTF-8 <w:sectPr>...</w:sectPr> element extracted from word/document.xml (Python zipfile + re).
note: Official template permits adapting section structure. Google Docs DOCX exports are not byte-reproducible; styles.xml and sectPr are stable across exports and are what the build uses.
